projects.title: Puspresnas Redesign
projects.short: Website and mobile redesign for Indonesia's national achievement center, built around its news and achievement content.

sections.overview: A redesign concept for the Puspresnas (Pusat Prestasi Nasional) website, the portal that publishes news and records of national student achievement. The goal was to make achievement stories easier to browse and to carry the same visual language over to a mobile app.

approach.title: Content first
approach.text: Structured the portal around what visitors come for: top topics, achievement news, posters and an achievement gallery.

approach.title: Consistent system
approach.text: Built one visual language, with colour, cards and typography, that works on both the website and the mobile app.

approach.title: App mockups
approach.text: Extended the website into a set of mobile screens so the two products feel like one.

projects.title: DreamJourney
projects.short: A travel discovery website and app concept for exploring destinations around Malang, with its own mascot.
projects.role: UI/UX Designer, Web Developer, Graphic Designer

sections.overview: DreamJourney helps travellers find where to go in and around Malang. The concept covers a website and a mobile app with destination search, popular places, destination details with maps, and a friendly tiger mascot, Rimbo.

approach.title: Destination discovery
approach.text: A search-first home page with popular destinations, then detail pages with descriptions and a map.

approach.title: Brand character
approach.text: Graphic work included the DreamJourney brand and the Rimbo mascot, which give the product a recognisable voice.

approach.title: From design to code
approach.text: Designed the interface and built the website, so design decisions were checked in the browser.

projects.title: BEM DCC Website
projects.short: Official website for the student executive board of ITBA Dian Cipta Cendikia.
projects.role: Website Designer, Frontend Designer, UI/UX Designer, Graphic Designer

sections.overview: The website of BEM DCC, the student executive board of ITBA Dian Cipta Cendikia. It presents the organisation's profile, programmes and media in one place.

projects.title: MBG vs Pemberdayaan
projects.short: A research study on public perception of the free nutritious meal programme compared with family economic empowerment, presented as an interactive page.

sections.overview: A Project-Based Learning study for Character Building Pancasila. It analyses how people perceive the effectiveness of the Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) programme compared with family economic empowerment for tackling malnutrition and poverty, and presents the method, interviews and findings as one interactive page.

approach.title: Frame
approach.text: Set the two policies side by side with national figures on poverty and stunting.

approach.title: Ask
approach.text: Collected perceptions through interviews with community members.

approach.title: Show
approach.text: Turned the findings and recommendations into a page anyone can read in minutes.

projects.title: JEJAK
projects.short: A visual companion to an essay on the hidden footprints of AI prompts, with a water-footprint calculator.

sections.overview: Every AI prompt leaves two footprints: one on academic honesty and one on the environment. JEJAK is the visual companion to the essay "Jejak yang Tak Terlihat". It shows the two crises in numbers, lets readers estimate their own water footprint with a calculator, and introduces the JEJAK idea.

approach.title: Numbers first
approach.text: Opened with the two crises as figures so the argument is visible before it is read.

approach.title: Make it personal
approach.text: Added a water-footprint calculator so readers can see their own impact.

projects.title: Tanam Harapan
projects.short: A visual narrative that invites young people to act for a greener earth, from digital education to planting trees.

sections.overview: "Tanam Harapan, Rawat Kehidupan" is a visual narrative that moves readers from learning about environmental issues to taking real action, ending with tree planting.
